mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is called to his/her office by the oracular institution, and so not by a god. v."
The prophet is called to his/her office by the oracular institution, and so not by a god. v.

Even stronger evidence is the fact that Hosea 3.1 refers to Hosea's wife as an 'adulteress'.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the two active prophets in the court during the reign of David."
Nathan and Gad are the two active prophets in the court during the reign of David.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are called prophets and in the remaining books of the prophets the word is not even used."
Only Habakkuk and Haggai are called prophets and in the remaining books of the prophets the word is not even used.

The plague of locusts is a cert ain sign of YHWH's wrath.

The book of Joel is one of the twelve Minor Prophets that together make up the concluding section of the OT.

Allied to irony is the author's almost comic use of exaggeration.

The book of Daniel is considered to be an example of the Jewish apocalyptic work.

The prophet Amos is called a ḥōzeh, perhaps in derision (Amos 7:12).

The Book of Jeremiah itself is composed of the literary genre of autobiography, biography, poetic oracle, the confessions of Jeremiah and historical appendix.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the reason for the coming punishment."
Sin is the reason for the coming punishment.

Only very little is known from the book about the life of the prophet Nahum himself.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a literary method in which an echoing oracle follows the main oracle as an after wave."
The halving technique is a literary method in which an echoing oracle follows the main oracle as an after wave.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a supernatural revelation of God given to a person in the form of a dream or trance-like state usually for the purpose of revealing the glory of God or the meaning of past or future events."

A vision is a supernatural revelation of God given to a person in the form of a dream or trance-like state usually for the purpose of revealing the glory of God or the meaning of past or future events.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means "Yo" (YHWH) is God." Incidentally, the name is popular in the Old Testament tradition. 1 Sam 8:2 tells us about one of the sons of David named Joel."
The name Joel means "Yo" (YHWH) is God." Incidentally, the name is popular in the Old Testament tradition. 1 Sam 8:2 tells us about one of the sons of David named Joel.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the prophet's expression of election and covenant more tender than in the masterful poetry of Hos. 11 :1-9."
Nowhere is the prophet's expression of election and covenant more tender than in the masterful poetry of Hos. 11 :1-9.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is concerned with the people's rejection of God."
Against False Security Micah is concerned with the people's rejection of God.

The name Haggai is derived from the word for "a festival," which would suggest that the prophet was born on some feast day.
